cues.text: Working hard, but still going nowhere?
Two brothers had one horse and one cart.
One put the horse behind the cart. Pushing was a struggle.
His brother moved the horse to the front.
Same horse. Same cart. A much easier journey.
Money can work the same way.
Buy first, and tomorrow's income pays for yesterday's purchase.
Where you can, change the order. Earn, save, then buy.
Imagine making car payments into savings before buying your next car.
Then keep saving for its replacement.
Your payments build savings, instead of repaying a loan with interest.
Put the horse first. Let's fix money.
